name: Noelle
description: A striking Dutch specialty with vivid purple skin and purple flesh that holds its color when cooked. The complex flavor balances butteriness with mild nuttiness. Firm texture makes it excellent for roasting and gratins where you want visual impact.

name: Viking Purple
description: German heirloom with deep purple skin and striking purple flesh. Notable for its sweet undertones and waxy texture that holds shape well. A showstopper for salads and chips where you want color that lasts through cooking.

name: Albertine
description: American variety prized for its golden flesh and rich buttery flavor. The mealy texture makes excellent mashed potatoes with natural richness. A reliable producer that stores exceptionally well through winter.

name: Violetta
description: Dutch variety combining attractive pink-rose skin with creamy yellow flesh. Fluffy texture when cooked makes it versatile for roasting, mashing, and gratins. The mild flavor takes well to butter and herbs.

name: Zoe
description: French fingerling with rosy pink skin and yellow flesh. High butteriness rating with mealy texture creates luxurious mashed potatoes. The elongated shape and complex flavor profile suits French cuisine beautifully.

name: Caribe
description: Early American variety with striking purple skin and creamy white flesh. The firm texture holds shape during cooking while delivering mild, approachable flavor. Excellent for boiling and roasting where the purple skin adds visual appeal.

name: Malou
description: American purple variety with matching purple skin and flesh. The waxy texture and mild flavor make it ideal for boiling and soups where it maintains its shape. Moist flesh absorbs seasonings well.

name: Elfie
description: American red-skinned variety with golden yellow flesh. The firm texture and mild flavor make it a reliable all-rounder. Moist flesh pairs well with roasting and soups where the red skin adds visual appeal.

name: Jester
description: British russet with attractive golden flesh beneath the traditional brown skin. Fluffy texture and mild buttery flavor excel in baking and frying. The nutty undertones complement both savory and simple preparations.

name: Cheshire
description: Peruvian heritage variety with clean white skin and flesh. The waxy texture holds shape beautifully for baking and roasting. Complex flavor with earthy depth reflects its South American origins.

name: Yukon Gold
description: The iconic golden potato developed in Canada in 1966. Loved for its buttery flavor and versatility. Creamy texture makes exceptional mashed potatoes without added butter. A kitchen staple that roasts, bakes, and fries beautifully.

name: King Edward
description: Classic British variety from 1902 with white skin often blushed pink, and creamy white flesh. Named after King Edward VII. The floury texture and complex flavor make it a favorite for roasting alongside Sunday joints. A heritage potato with royal pedigree.

name: Kennebec
description: American classic developed in Maine in 1948, known for excellent frying quality. The fluffy texture and mild flavor made it the original choice for potato chips. Large tubers with buff-white skin and white flesh are highly productive.

name: Montana
description: Dutch variety with distinctive bicolor skin pattern and golden flesh. The waxy texture excels in roasting where the skin crisps beautifully. Complex flavor with moderate sweetness suits Mediterranean preparations.

name: Russet Norkotah
description: Premier baking potato with classic russet appearance and high starch content. The dry, fluffy texture when baked creates the ideal canvas for butter and toppings. A commercial standard developed in North Dakota.

name: Red Pontiac
description: American red-skinned classic from the 1940s with smooth white flesh. The moist, waxy texture makes it popular for boiling and potato salads. Thin red skin adds color while the flesh stays creamy. Excellent for new potatoes.

name: Peruvian Sunrise Gold
description: German variety with sunny yellow skin and matching golden flesh. The mealy texture and mild flavor make it a reliable choice for frying and chips. Produces large tubers with excellent storage potential.

name: All Red
description: True red-fleshed potato where the color extends throughout. Sweet flavor with firm texture that holds up to cooking. Exceptional for roasting and salads where the red color creates visual drama.

name: Yukon Gem
description: Canadian specialty combining purple skin with golden yellow flesh - a colorful twist on Yukon Gold parentage. The creamy texture and buttery flavor shine in roasting and mashing. Excellent where you want visual impact with familiar flavor.

name: Agata
description: Dutch early variety widely grown in Europe. Light yellow skin with pale yellow flesh. The firm, waxy texture holds shape well for salads and boiling. Mild flavor profile makes it adaptable to various cuisines.

name: Red La Soda

name: Ciklamen
description: German variety with golden skin and rich cream-colored flesh. The creamy texture and buttery flavor make exceptional soups. High moisture content delivers smooth results in purees and gratins.

name: Chieftain

name: Vermillion Fingerling

name: All Blue

name: Purple Majesty
description: American variety bred for intense purple color throughout both skin and flesh. The moist texture and mild flavor hold up to various cooking methods. High antioxidant content makes it as nutritious as it is beautiful.

name: Norland

name: Huckleberry Gold
description: American specialty with purple skin and golden yellow flesh. The waxy texture and buttery flavor make it versatile for roasting and salads. An attractive variety that combines color with great taste.

name: Russet Pioneer
description: American russet with classic brown russeted skin and white flesh. The fluffy texture and mild flavor excel in baking. High starch content makes it ideal for light, fluffy baked potatoes.

name: Russet Burbank

name: German Butterball
description: Heritage variety prized for its exceptional buttery flavor and golden flesh throughout. The fluffy texture makes silky mashed potatoes. Yellow skin with golden flesh is easy to identify.

name: Ramona
description: Dutch variety with red skin and white flesh. The firm texture and mild flavor make good boiling potatoes. Reliable producer with attractive appearance.

name: Terra Rosa
description: Canadian specialty with red skin and pink-rose colored flesh. The firm texture and mild flavor make it interesting for salads. The pink interior creates visual interest when sliced.

name: Defender

name: Jelly

name: Russian Banana

name: Austrian Crescent

name: Red Thumb

name: Yukon Gold Organic

name: Chieftain Organic

name: Russian Blue
